verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers LangGraph's graph orchestration, persistence, streaming, and human-in-the-loop features, but nothing addresses swapping LLM providers/models without rewriting agent code (e.g., no mention of a unified chat-model interface, provider-agnostic model binding, or config-driven model selection). Missing for 10: any documentation of a model abstraction layer, provider-swap examples, or config-based model selection.
